how: Computers played each other with the real rules (Clue rules, 4 players unless noted). The tested computer took every seat in turn so going first didn't skew it. Measured 2026-10-19 with tools/sim.js. A fair share is 25% with 4 players.

vs.label: Hard vs 3 Medium
vs.note: 400 games. Fair share is 25%. Hard counts every possible deal and asks the most useful question.

vs.label: Medium vs 3 Easy
vs.note: 200 games, measured 2026-10-20 after Easy learned the "nobody could answer" trick.

seatHow: 400 games, four Medium computers, Clue rules. Each bar is how often that seat won.
seatNote: Going first is worth about 7 points over a fair 25%: the first player gets the first question in.
length: With 4 players a game takes about 35 turns, so about 9 turns each. With the newer rules (2 dice, move up to the roll) it drops to about 20 turns.
